name: secrets-rotation-p3
prompt: how do I rotate the database password without breaking running services that hold the old credential

chunks.content: decided to keep two valid database credentials live at once during a rotation window so in-flight services using the previous password keep authenticating until they pick up the new one
the rotation job writes the fresh credential to the secret store, waits for every pod to reload it, then revokes the superseded password so no connection is dropped mid-swap
the account password reset flow emails the user a one-time link that expires after 15 minutes and forces a new password on next login
added a Grafana panel charting p95 request latency split by upstream service
each worker polls the secret manager every 30 seconds and reconnects its pool against the latest database credential without a restart, so old and new passwords overlap briefly
the analytics export streams rows to a CSV file in chunks of 5000 to avoid loading the whole table into memory
the database password policy now requires 20 characters with mixed case and a symbol, and rejects any password reused within the last 10 changes
wrapped the new onboarding wizard behind a toggle defaulting to off for existing tenants
avatar uploads are resized to 256x256 and converted to WebP before storage
send a Slack alert to the on-call channel whenever a deploy fails health checks
set the session cookie with SameSite=Lax and a 12-hour max age
default the UI locale from the Accept-Language header, falling back to English
scale the worker deployment up when the job queue depth exceeds 1000 for two minutes
updated the README with local setup steps for the docker-compose stack
